issues: The inference that the attack itself can be shown is not clearly supported: the text says the conspirators obtained Jared’s head and that Jared was murdered, but does not specify the method or depict the act. Depict Jared seated with his audience; treat the murder as narration rather than a shown attack. The previous scene’s events are correctly kept separate.
“Akish’s land” is an inferred location; the source only says Nimrah fled out of the land and dwelt with Omer.
Restoration and the later anointing are distinct events; the scene notes this, but should not depict them as simultaneous.
The two years of peace, Omer’s death, and Emer’s succession occur in sequence, not as one instant; the scene notes this distinction.
The source reports that Emer saw the Son of Righteousness but gives no appearance; do not visually portray an unspecified form.
The warning and the later persecution are separate moments; the scene notes this and should not depict them simultaneously.
The dearth and the serpents’ arrival are distinct events; the scene notes this and should not combine them as simultaneous.
Eating the carcasses and the later repentance are separate moments; the scene notes this and should not depict them simultaneously.
